title: Doppel’s AI defense system stops attacks before they spread
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Doppel uses GPT-5 and reinforcement fine-tuning to stop deepfake and impersonation attacks, cutting analyst workloads by 80% and reducing response times from hours to minutes....
body:
